notes.title: Exovoid - Update 2024-06-18-a
notes.content:
[h1]Exovoid Update - Fall Damage, Cinematics, and more[/h1]

[h2]New![/h2]
[list]
[*]Fall Damage! - Edgar will now take damage when falling from a great height
[*]You Died - The death screen will now tell you what evils in Exovoid killed you
[*]Easy on the Eyes - Moved the Health and Energy Bars to the lower area making it easier to see
[*]They are watching - A mysterious creature is stalking you
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed audio issues with enemy ambush sounds
[*]Fixed audio on pickups
[/list]

notes.title: Exovoid - Update 2024-06-13-a
notes.content:
[h1]The newest update for Exovoid brings new combat features, stability and improvements.[/h1]

[h2]New![/h2]
[list]
[*] Game Intro - The intro now has more impactful moments, a surprise you will have to play to see.
[*] Combat Damage Numbers - Now when you shoot enemies, you will see damage numbers fly off, showing you how much caring you can unleash.
[*] Weapon Impacts - Weapons have more "oomph" when firing.
[*] What's That Sound? - Pickup items have a sound they play as you get closer, letting you find hidden goodies.
[*] Attack! - The first combat encounters have been retooled to better introduce players to the brutal world of Exovoid, but still provide a challenge.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the player Jump to be less floaty.
[*] Updated the game engine to Unreal Engine 5.4
[*] Improved general stability and performance
[/list]

notes.title: Exovoid - Demo Update - 2024.06.07.a
notes.content:
[h1]Exovoid Demo Update brings bug fixes, and quality of life improvements.  [/h1]


New Features include:

[list]
[*] Visual Lighting Overhaul
[*] Improvements to Inventory and Belt Management
[*] Improved enemy pathfinding
[*] Improved Brute attacking
[*] Added additional weapon impact and visual effects
[/list]

Game Balancing
[list]
[*] Adjusted drop rates to give more Void Matter
[*] Removed health pickups from enemies
[/list]

Bugs Fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent enemies from taking damage in some situations
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Revitalizer from working properly
[*] Fixed a lighting issue on the Brute that would look incorrect in some situations
[*] Fixed a bug with the Explosive Bolt Gun that would cause an incorrect animation when Aiming Down the Sights
[/list]
